$description: The note page's own sidebar (components/doc/DocumentSidebar.tsx, Outline.tsx): the note card, the tool tabs and their panels. Every screen opens Home, then the fixture note "Kyoto in November", then a tab; the last one (contents) leaves the Contents tab chosen, as a fresh library has it.
